name: Lone Star Fur Con
blurb: Austin-area furry convention at the Hilton Austin Airport, with panels, dances and its own Queertopia charity.

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'LSFC 2027 February 25-28, 2027 Hilton Austin Airport - Austin, TX'; registration page confirms 'Full access to Lone Star Fur Con 2027'.

notes: The site's own /guest-of-honor page rendered with no names or photos (0 candidates), even though registration sells a 'Guest of Honor Dinner' add-on, so no GoH has been publicly announced yet. Homepage states 2026 attendance was 1,179 (+34% year over year) and that 2027 is the convention's 3rd year.
